tei:div.tei:p: 495) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rdo rje phag mo'i smin byed gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thun min nges don mkha' 'gro'i thugs chud ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zab rgya can no: 496) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: (Dakini secret letter here) sku gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: ma 'ongs pad+ma'i rjes 'jug skal ldan gyi: gsang ba'i sgor zhugs sngags kyi lam chen po: bla med rnal 'byor mchog la spyod pa'i tshe: dbyings yum mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo yi: byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i rim pa 'di ru bstan: skal ldan sems kyi bu yis nyams su longs: sgo gsum gsang gsum 'khor lo'i rgyan du smin: sa ma ya: gnas ni rkyen bral yid 'ong dben gnas su: nyams pa la sogs 'tshe ba med pa ru: dkyil 'khor legs bkod gtor ma bum pa dang: bhan thod sku tsaka la sogs bshams nas kyang: bdag bdun bum pa bskyed bzlas bdag 'jug blangs: dbang ldan slob dpaun he ru'i chas gsol nas: skal ldan slob ma gral 'khod khrus bya zhing: bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom zhing lo rgyus bshad: mos gus bskyed nas maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i mthar: thal mo dang bcas gsol ba bdab pa ni: e ma: bde chen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa: slob dpon mchog nyid dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i smin byed dbang: yongs rdzogs dam pa bstsal du gsol: zhes lan gsum brjod nas: rdo rje slob dpon gyis lan gdab pa ni: 497)kye ho: rigs ldan skyes bu gang su dag: gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa spro bar byed pa la: dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung nus sam: bde chen mkha' 'gro bsgrub nus sam: dam tshig ldan na dbang mchog bstsal: dam dang mi ldan phyir dengs shig: slar slob bu nas zhu ba: bde ba chen po'i don ston slob dpon dgongs: gsang sngags phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams: rdo rje rgyal pos ci bsgo'i bka' bzhin du:

srog gi phyir du mi 'da' gta' ru gzung: zhes zhus rjes su 'jug pa'i sgo: gsang ba'i gab thig ltar du bya: de nas mig ras me tog gtad la: oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: oṃ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐: de nas ye shes dbab cing slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra= ko3haṃ: gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus chos rnams stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las sgyu 'phrul rol pa ru: bdag mdun ting 'dzin byin rlabs stobs chen pos: slob ma'i sgo gsum ma dag sgrib tshogs dang: gdos bcas phung po dang bcas stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 498)'od gong baṃ yig mtshan: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas tshur 'dus: yongs gyur pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i steng: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor la: rdo rje phag mo dmar gsal zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing spyan gsum ldan: dbu skra khams ser gyen 'khyil phag zhal ngur: thod skam dbu brgyan thod rlon do shal 'phyang: gzig sham smad dkris zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums shing: g.yon brkyangs bam ro dmar ser snying gar brdzis: sku la khro mo'i chas kun ma lus rdzogs: dpa' bo yab tshul kha ṭ+wām̐ mchan g.yon 'chang: gnas lngar sgyu 'phrul ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga: rtsa thig rlung khams mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: rdo rje gsum las 'od 'phros 'og min gnas: gsang chen rol pa'i zhing nas ye shes pa: spyan drangs dam tshig rten dang dbyer med gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rol mo dang bcas 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min mkha' spyod gnas kyi mchog: dhu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i grong: gling gi gling mchog gsang chen rol: chos dbyings rnam dag zhing khams nas: kun tu bzang mo rgyal ba'i 499)yum: rdo rje phag mo gtso dang 'khor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la:

byin chen dbab pa'i dus la babs: dbang chen bskur ba'i dus la babs: dus la bab bo ye shes lha: da lta nyid du dbang byin phobs: sgrub mchog sgo gsum dag smin cing: ye shes chen por yongs rdzogs nas: 'ja' lus zang thal byin chen phobs: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya pheṃ pheṃ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod nas: ye shes pa de nyid rab tu brtan par gyur cig tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas me tog 'bul ba ni: hoḥ bdag cag rtse gcig dad pa yis: rig pa'i me tog lha la 'bul: lhag pa'i lha la dbab nas kyang: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par shog: pad+ma puṣ+pe sid+dhi trām̐: zhes phul: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: hrīḥ rang byung ye shes sangs rgyas dngos: ma rig sgrib pa gsum gyis gos: thabs mchog rdo rje'i thur ma yis: shes rab gsal ba'i spyan du dbye: oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu: chos dbyings mtha' bral ye shes 500)che: kun zlum thig le rang byung klong: lhun grub rang gsal dkyil 'khor ni: tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs: phyi nang gsal sgrib med pa yi: yon tan yongs rdzogs lhun gyis grub: gsang ba ye shes dkyil 'khor 'di: mthong ba tsam gyis sgrib pa dag: sgom pa tsam gyis dngos grub 'thob: chos nyid mngon gyur sangs rgyas 'gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal la pra be sha ya a āḥ de nas dngos dbang zab mor 'jug phyir maṇ+ḍal phul: gsol ba gdab pa 'di skad do: e maḥgasang chen rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dngos gzhi'i dbang: lam mchog dam pa bstsal du gsol: lan gsum zhus rjes 'di skad brjod: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: gsang ba ye shes dngos gzhi'i dbang: 'jug par 'dod pa gang su dag: las dang skal bar ldan pa yin: spro ba bskyed la dam tshig srungs: nyams na dmyal bar ltung ta re:

de bas ma nyams tshul bzhin srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: dam tshig bdud rtsi ngag tu blud: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral chos sku'i bum pa ru: lhun grub rig stong bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur 501)ro: rang byung mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dbang 'thob shog: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: gtso mo'i sku thogs la: e ma skal ldan rnying gi bu: rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byor ma: chos nyid ngang las so sor gsal: 'gag med ye shes rtogs pa'i yum: rdo rje phag mo'i gsang gsum dbang: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang thob shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa hūm̐: kā ya= rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: gsang mchog rdo rje ḍā ki rnal 'byor mas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: thabs byung 'od gsal mngon du 'gyur pa dang: me long ye shes mchog gi dbang 'thob shog: badz+ra ḍā ki ni kā ya= rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: gsang mchog rin chen= deng 'dir= thabs byung= mnyam nyid ye shes= rat+na ḍā ki ni kā ya= pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: gsang mchog pad+ma= deng 'dir= thabs byung= sor rtogs ye shes= pad+ma ḍā ki ni kā ya= las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: gsang mchog karma= deng 'dir= thabs byung= bya grub ye shes= karma ḍā ki ni kā ya= sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sku thogs la: 502)hūm̐: gsang mchog bud+dha= deng 'dir= thabs byung= chos dbyings ye shes= bud+dha ḍā ki ni= sgo ma bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med mthar phyin ye shes sgo ma bzhis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: tshad med rnam bzhi'i 'gro don mthar phyin cing: phrin las thogs med 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkā ya= de nas bdud rtsi thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ gsal stong 'gags med bhan+dha ru:

rang byung ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyil: grags stong a li ka li 'phro: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi dbang: skye med rdo rje'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de nas thugs srog chos 'byung bam̐ mtshan thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings mtha' bral thig le'i klong: chos sku 'gyur med bam̐ yig mtshan: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dbang: chos kyi rdo rje'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas bas thun min gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni: hrīḥ mi mo brgyad gnyis lang tsho can: yid 'ong ḍa ki'-i sgyu 'phrul ni: gsang 'dzin rnal 'byor thabs shes lam: bgrod pa'i dbang mchog bskur bar bgyi: zhes brjod la 503)spro ba bskyed cing: bla ma lha dang dkyil 'khor la: yol bas g.yog cing slob bu ni: sgo gsum dad cing gus pa yis: gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya: kyai: gsang sngags 'dzin mdzad rdo rje 'chang: slob dpon mchog nyid dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin stsol: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jug par spro: zhes zhus rdo rje slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu: zung 'jug lam la ma brten par: mngon gyur sangs rgyas thon mi srid: de phyir gsang ba ye shes kyi: dbang byin dngos grub bdag gis bstsal: ci bsgo'i bka' bzhin bsgrub nus sam: pad+ma'i bcud la myong nus sam: gzhon nu brnyen bkur byed nus sam: dam tshig ji bzhin bsrung nus sam: bsrung na dkyil 'khor nang du 'jug: mi nus pa rnams phyir dengs shig: ces bskul nas rigs ldan slob bus khas blangs pa ni: kye hoḥ gsang chen don ston rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu mchog la: shes rab ye shes dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: slob dpon bka' bsgos ci bzhin bdag gis bsgrub:

rtsa ba ḍā ki'i dam tshig ji bzhin bsrung: zhes zhus nas mdun du 'khod do: dbang yon maṇ+ḍal phul 504)nas gsol gdab ni: e ma rdo rje 'chang chen slob dpon dgongs: gsang ba'i lam mchog shes rab dbang: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i nye rgyu'i gar: gsang ba'i dbang mchog bka' drin stsol: zhes zhus slob dpon 'di skad do: e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu: sngags kyi lam mchog mthar thug pa: dka' ba med cing grol ba'i thabs: shes rab mchog la brten nas ni: spang thob bral ba'i 'bras bu rnyed: mchog gi lam la 'jug spro na: srog gi phyir yang dam ma 'da': mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i dam tshig tu: rdo rje slob dpon bkur zhing rnyen: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu: chos nyid don la rtag tu sgoms: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i= dus kun tshogs gtor rgyun mi gcod: pad+ma mkha' 'gro= gzhon nu ma la brnyen bkur dang: rgyan dang mchod pas mnyes par bya: ting 'dzin dag pas bde ba bskul: karma mkha' 'gro'i= phyogs ris bral ba'i dag snang brtson: spyi yi mkha' 'gro'i= mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus rnams su: tshogs kyi 'dod yon dpag med dang: sgom sgrub me yis mchod par bya: 'di rnams mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig yin: tshul bzhin bsrung na dngos grub thob: nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung: de phyir dam la ma 'da' zhig: 505) badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes brjod la gsal gdab pa ni: slob dpon gyis snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: 'o: rigs kyi bu rnams: thabs shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lam 'dir ma brten par mngon gyur dang po'i sangs rgyas thob par mi 'gyur ro: de'i phyir na lam mchog khyad par can bde stong dga' ba bzhi yis nye bar drangs pa'i 'od gsal chen po mngon du gyur pa'i thabs dang: ye shes dang las las grub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bu bzhin du snying brtse zhing mkha' spyaud kyi gnas thams cad du ḍā ki ma rnams kyi tshogs rje tshogs dpon du bkur nas rang byung gi ye shes chen por mnga' brnyes par bya ba'i dbang byin dngos grub dam pa bdag gis stsol bar byed pa la:

khyed rnams tha mal gyi snang zhen ldog nas rang byung gi rig pa sku dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin pas dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi rnam par snang rtog lha'i phyag rgya ru sgoms shig: ces brjod rig ma sbyin pa ni: āḥ skye med chos sku kun bzang mo: ma 'gags rnal 'byor wā ra hi'i: sgyu 'phrul dz+nyā na sā ga ra'i: byin rlabs ye shes nye rgyu'i gar: shes rab mchog gi pho nya mo: bcu drug pad+ma lang tsho ldan: 506) skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: rtsa thig rlung gsum dag smin rdzogs: nang gsal ye shes mngon gyur nas: shes rab chen po'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha a haṃ mu dra a bhi ṣiñca a a āḥ zhes brjod cing yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas ngo sprod gab thig ltar du bya: de nas sin+dhu ra dang ling khri thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ gsang chen ḍā ki'i bcud kyis gtams: li khris dpa' bo dbang du sdud: sin+dhur ni ḍā ki'i rten: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zung 'jug mthar phyin dbang thob shog: ces brjod dpa' bo'i gnas sngar li khri yis: oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ āḥ rnams bkod cing: sarba a bhi ṣiñca badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha s+t+wam̐: rig ma'i gnas lngar: māṃ pāṃ mūṃ lāṃ tāṃ: sarba a bhi ṣiñca tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra s+t+wam̐: a li ka lis me tog 'thor: de nas man shel le long thogs la: āḥ smra bsam brjod med rig pa tshig dang bral: spros mtha' brgyad bral kun zlum mi shigs thig: gdangs rtsal ma 'gags ye shes rang gsal bar: gsal sgrib med pa me long man shel mtshon: 'dzin pa rang grol brda yi dbang bskur ro: ka dag rig pa snang bzhi 507)mthar son nas: nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku mngon gyur te: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: ga ga sarba a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung tshad ldan gtor snod du: lhun grub brjid ldan ba liṃ ta:

rig stong mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: snang cha lha yi phyag rgyar dag: rtsa rlung thig le bcud du smin: lhun grub bde chen rig par rdzogs: sku gsum ye shes dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: ma hā ba liṃ ta sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hrī: zhes brjod gtor ma gnas lngar gtug: mtha' brten gtad nas dam tshig khas blangs gtang rag phul: sku drin gzo ba'i slad du ni: bla ma lha yi dkyil 'khor du: bdag ni yongs su 'bul bar bgyi: bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas kyang: bskyed rdzogs nyams len tshul bzhin bsgrub: lan gsum rjes zlos bya: bka' drin me tog 'thor nas kyang: bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis btab: de yis sems ma mkha' 'gro'i dbang: skal ldan bu la 'thob par nges: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: sa ma ya: e ma: gsang ba'i zab bcud khyad 'phags pa: bde chen mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor 508)ma'i: gsang dbang ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin: yang zab mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud 'di: pad+mas mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: snying mig srog las phangs na yang: phyi rabs skal ldan skyes ba rnams: gsang sngags rjes 'dzin thabs zab mo: a tsār sa les brda ru thob: mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas pad+ma rdzong: g.yu sgras zab mo gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe: mi srin bdud rnams 'dul ba'i phyir: nga sprul su kha badz+ra rtsal: smon lam gtad rgya dus babs tshe: thabs grogs pad+ma'i rigs can dang: phrad nas zab gter 'di bton tshe: 'gro don shar dang lho nas 'byung: mtha' dmag lnga bcu'i bar du bzlog: chos bdag mchog gi bu lnga dang: phrad nas chos 'dis smin nas kyang: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mchog 'thob: don gnyis bstan pa mthar rgyas shog: las can bu dang 'phrad par smon: log lta can dang 'di ma 'phrad: dam nyams rnams la gu h+ya rgyaḥ sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: (Dakini

secret letter here) gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang gsang gter rgya mtsho'i lde mig thabs grogs mtshan gyur o rgyan dngos snang pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pas rin chen su war+ṇa dang pañca dbang mdog 'dzin pa'i skyes bcas bka' bstsal spyi bor son pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag po pad+ma snyan grags kyis thabs shes rdor dril/ rin chen pad rag gi 509) mdangs kyis skyes bcas bskul ngor/ dus mtha'i gter ming 'dzin pa kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i shog ser las zhal bshus te sgrub khang 'od gsal 'khyil bar dus tshes dge bar gtan la phab pa'o// dge'o// legs so/ phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ dza yan+tu// phag mo'i dbang bshad skabs su/ da lan gyi skabs su babs pa rma rgyal nub kyi sgo srung dbang phyug ma bdun gyi gnas gangs ri seng ge 'gying 'dra'i mdun ngos nas ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos kyi skor las/ rdo rje phag mo'i smin byed gsang dbang nges don mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa= sogs dbang gi lhan thabs ltar ro//
